exam.title: Professional Agentic Architect
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; Google recommends three or more years building cloud solutions including one or more years building agents on Google Cloud. Practice low-code state workflows, sandboxed coding agents, ADK/custom agents, RAG/memory/tools/MCP/A2A/multi-agent coordination, layered eval and tracing, Agent Runtime/Cloud Run/GKE deployment, OAuth/IAM/PAB/gateway/registry/policy/HITL controls and incident rollback.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Using coding agents for application development (~17%)

guide_sections: Section 3 including the blueprint-named data/model service map
Section 4 and Google Cloud Observability mapping

review.notes: All five beta domains, the complete blueprint-named product groups and two-part assessment contract are mapped through bounded agent purpose; data, memory and retrieval; Cloud Storage, BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Firestore and Memorystore selection; Model Garden; tool identity/actions; protocols/orchestration; layered evaluation/deployment; Google Cloud Observability; and security/governance/rollback. Three scenarios, eight labs and 42 checks are included. All 16 URLs are registered and reachable. The September 3–30 registration, September 8–30 testing, late-October results, late-October-to-December qualifying labs, projected mid-November GA and Workflow Builder rename are dated and explicitly volatile. No leaked/recalled beta item, dump or proprietary lab is used.

findings.title: Preparation labs are not the certification assessment
findings.evidence: The FAQ says preparation is optional and qualifying assessment labs are separate; both components must pass.
findings.recommendation: Teach current windows, component-specific results, one-year validity and projected GA without treating training completion as certification.
findings.resolution: Teach current windows, component-specific results, one-year validity and projected GA without treating training completion as certification.

findings.title: Capability digest changed only because of a FAQ pointer
findings.evidence: The saved unified diff adds one navigation sentence after the existing capability/two-part text.
findings.recommendation: Accept the inspected snapshot explicitly and retain before/after/diff receipts without claiming new exam objectives.
findings.resolution: Accept the inspected snapshot explicitly and retain before/after/diff receipts without claiming new exam objectives.

findings.title: Blueprint and current low-code naming differ
findings.recommendation: Retain blueprint wording while naming the current product and mapping lifecycle concepts to actual tool capabilities.
findings.resolution: Retain blueprint wording while naming the current product and mapping lifecycle concepts to actual tool capabilities.

findings.title: Experimental confirmation has session-service limitations
findings.evidence: Known limitations exclude DatabaseSessionService and VertexAiSessionService.
findings.recommendation: Require compatible version/backend and actual resume testing; a dialog is not evidence of durable production approval.
findings.resolution: Require compatible version/backend and actual resume testing; a dialog is not evidence of durable production approval.

findings.title: State scope and persistence do not establish authority
findings.evidence: App state spans users; in-memory state is lost; retrieved-Session mutation bypasses tracked update flow.
findings.recommendation: Teach scoped data,tracked context/event updates and host-controlled authority outside model-writable state.
findings.resolution: Teach scoped data,tracked context/event updates and host-controlled authority outside model-writable state.

findings.title: Parallel branches need explicit state and merge contracts
findings.evidence: Documentation warns about independent branches/shared-context races and newer2.0workflow alternatives.
findings.recommendation: Pin SDK/runtime and test synchronization,result ordering,merge and failure behavior.
findings.resolution: Pin SDK/runtime and test synchronization,result ordering,merge and failure behavior.

findings.title: A required trajectory can coexist with an unsafe extra action
findings.evidence: IN_ORDER and ANY_ORDER permit extras; word-overlap and semantic judges measure other properties.
findings.recommendation: Add forbidden-action/authorization gates and execute a separate trace counterexample.
findings.resolution: Add forbidden-action/authorization gates and execute a separate trace counterexample.

findings.title: Model tool arguments are not trusted authorization context
findings.evidence: In-tool guidance separates model-proposed arguments from developer-controlled policy and per-tool authority.
findings.recommendation: Execute a synthetic bound-approval/current-access/resource-version/idempotency transaction with rollback tests; state its trusted-host limits.
findings.resolution: Execute a synthetic bound-approval/current-access/resource-version/idempotency transaction with rollback tests; state its trusted-host limits.

findings.title: Protocol compatibility and delegated token audience are separate contracts
findings.evidence: Current2026HTTPauthorization requires intended audience validation and prohibits token passthrough; stdio differs.
findings.recommendation: Pin protocol/SDK/transport, use correct receiving-resource tokens and bounded error handling; do not claim old examples prove current compliance.
findings.resolution: Pin protocol/SDK/transport, use correct receiving-resource tokens and bounded error handling; do not claim old examples prove current compliance.

findings.title: A terminal task cannot simply restart for refinement
findings.evidence: Task lifecycle defines terminal states and separate follow-up tasks linked by context/references.
findings.recommendation: Separate task identity,context continuity and accepted artifact version management.
findings.resolution: Separate task identity,context continuity and accepted artifact version management.

findings.title: Multiple PAB policies add eligible resources rather than intersecting them
findings.evidence: Eligible resource union and enforcement-version supported permissions govern blocking; eligibility doesnot grant access.
findings.recommendation: Review all applicable bindings,permission support and removal gaps before claiming resource exclusion.
findings.resolution: Review all applicable bindings,permission support and removal gaps before claiming resource exclusion.

findings.title: Recreating an agent changes its principal and does not remove old bindings
findings.evidence: Identity follows resourceID; deletion leaves inactive IAM bindings and replacement requires new grants.
findings.recommendation: Add old-binding cleanup and new-principal least-privilege validation to deployment and retirement labs.
findings.resolution: Add old-binding cleanup and new-principal least-privilege validation to deployment and retirement labs.
